messages:
maria_g: @here quick recap from call w/ OpenWeights Labs — they're aiming to commercialize a quantized 4-bit variant via cloud marketplaces + SI bundles. Main question: can Redwood host/redistribute the artifact (for marketplace downloads), or will OW restrict to model-as-a-service only? Also they asked about co-marketing + launch timing. :wave:

jonathan_k: If redistribution is allowed that's a different legal + ops flow. If not, we can still list a 'Hosted by Redwood' SKU pointing to our inference offering. Need export control + repro rights clarified. @kevin_legal can you pull precedent from the Lumen/Orchid deals?

kevin_legal: Need the license text. Two likely paths:
- redistribute allowed (with attribution, export control clause, and patent covenant)
- redistribute prohibited -> inference-only

If they want redistribution we'll need a Commercial Addendum and a short distribution clause. Example snippet we can propose:
```
Distribution Grant: Licensor grants Redwood a non-exclusive, worldwide right to distribute the Model in binary form, provided Redwood (a) retains attribution, (b) includes the supplied export-control notice, and (c) does not sublicense beyond downstream customers for research or inference-only purposes. Any commercial redistribution requires mutual written consent.
```
I'll draft options after I see the OW draft. Also confirm indemnity/support expectations.

sora: Technical notes — packaging & verification:
- Offerable artifacts: (1) hosted container image (no weights packaged) (2) downloadable quantized bundle (if license permits) with checksum + provenance.json + test vectors
- Quant format: GGUF/4-bit int (specify quantization script)
- We'll need an ingest test: `./run_infer --model ./bundle --input test.json` and hash checks
- If we host downloads we must sign the bundle and store SLSA-like provenance. Ops + infra required.

paul_ops: Marketplace/ops checklist:
- EULA + support tier + SLOs
- infra footprint estimate (min GPU), deploy matrix: [L4, A10G, H100] + sharding notes
- billing split / revenue share request from OW (need numbers)
- export control & CN/US screening
I'll create a Partners intake ticket with these fields.

emma_sales: Co-marketing ask from OW:
- joint press release (2-week embargo)
- logo usage guidelines & approval flow
- 2 customer case studies in first 90 days
I'll coordinate with PR & AMs. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Created issue #partners-412: 'OpenWeights commercialization: license review, packaging, marketplace listing' assigned to @maria_g, @kevin_legal, @sora.

maria_g: Proposed timeline:
- 48h: OW provides license draft + quant bundle sample
- 1 week: legal + eng review
- 2 weeks: marketplace listing + joint PR prep (if redistribution allowed)

jonathan_k: One more thing — SI bundling. We should define a reseller addendum: can SIs include the model in their managed service? If redistribution allowed we need carveouts. @kevin_legal pls add reseller clause options.

kevin_legal: Will prepare two templates: (A) Model Redistribution Addendum (B) Model-as-a-Service Addendum. Also will include export-control text. Expect draft by end of day tomorrow.

sora: I'll prep the packaging pipeline and a small CI job to validate bundles. If we end up hosting downloads we should require signed artifacts and automated verification at ingest.

maria_g: Thanks — action owners: kevin (legal), sora (packaging CI), paul (partners intake ticket + infra estimate), emma (PR). I'll follow up with OW and share their draft. :raised_hands:
